fig07 (2026-08-06 update #5): O++ split from O+ as a 5th row, per request. Surfaced a real ambiguity FIRST (3 different O++ tables in this repo: strict omission_class=='O++' 15 units, grand_oplusplus_units.csv 39 units PFC/FEF-only, omission_oplusplus_grand_units.csv 1144 rows with a constant is_oplusplus_conjunction column flagged as likely a candidate/screened table not a final filter) -- asked before picking one rather than guessing; user chose the strict 15-unit definition. Consequence: only FEF and V4 clear the extraction's min-units/min-sessions floors (1 session each), so O++ shows only 2 areas with data, no significance possible (n<3 sessions), PFC/TEO blank -- documented as a real coverage limit, not a bug. GLMM refit: O++ not significant (p=0.71), all other coefficients essentially unchanged; noted a numerical side effect (huge SE on one subject fixed-effect term) without letting it affect the reported findings.
